stemMd: All members of team A are trained. Some trained people are not members of team A. Which statement is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Team A has every trained person.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Training is necessary for team A membership but not sufficient to establish it.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No team A member is trained.

options.label: E
options.textMd: No trained person can join team A.

explanationMd: Membership implies training, making training necessary. The existence of trained people outside the team shows training alone does not establish membership. The two statements distinguish subset inclusion from equality.

distractorRationale.d: The second premise gives trained nonmembers.
distractorRationale.a: The second premise explicitly denies this.
distractorRationale.e: The premises do not prohibit membership.
